s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic inflammation with polyarthritis and granulomatous lesions
salient_findings: Six weeks of low-grade fever and fatigue
Multiple dull red tender nodules on the forehead, cheek, and sternum
Bilateral upper and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions on chest radiograph
key_facts: No history of high-risk sexual behavior
Negative for antinuclear antibodies, IgM-rheumatoid factor, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, antistreptolysin O, and anti-DNase B antibodies
Normal serum calcium and angiotensin-converting enzyme levels
Negative urine examination for Gonococci spp.
Negative serum Venereal Disease Research Laboratory test for syphilis
Skin lesion biopsy: Granulomatous inflammation with suppuration
Cervical lymph node biopsy: Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli

differentials: Sjögren's syndrome with granulomatous interstitial lung disease
STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy
per_call: Sjögren's syndrome with granulomatous interstitial lung disease
STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy

shortlist.label: Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive Ziehl-Neelsen staining for acid-fast bacilli and granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation with suppuration and bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates

shortlist.label: Chronic granulomatous disease
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous lesions and positive acid-fast bacilli staining

shortlist.label: Erythema induratum
shortlist.why_kept: Dull red tender nodules on the forehead, left cheek, and sternum

raw.rationale: The presence of acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen staining, granulomatous inflammation with suppuration on skin lesion biopsy, and epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans' multinucleated giant cells on cervical lymph node biopsy are characteristic findings of tuberculosis. The clinical presentation of low-grade fever, fatigue, progressive polyarthritis, and multiple dull red tender nodules also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal serum calcium and angiotensin-converting enzyme levels, and lack of other typical findings such as uveitis or pulmonary symptoms

rejected.label: Chronic granulomatous disease
rejected.why: Absence of recurrent infections and normal neutrophil function suggested by negative tests for antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: Negative tests for antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies and lack of upper respiratory tract involvement

rejected.label: Erythema induratum
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and biopsy findings are not typical for erythema induratum, which usually presents with recurrent nodules on the calves
